title: Precision Fader: phased model deployment orchestrator and policy DSL
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a general-purpose phased deployment orchestrator ("Precision Fader") and a compact policy DSL that lets product/platform teams define traffic splits, step schedules, shadow probes, A/B variant routing and auto-rollback guardrails in a single, auditable config. The goal is a declarative config language + enforcement runtime that integrates with Redwood routing, Console rollouts UI, and the telemetry pipeline. Should support: per-route schedules, cohort targeting, staged ramp durations, shadow sampling, simulated rollouts, and strict safety checks before traffic increases.
acceptance_criteria: Policy DSL supports traffic split primitives, time/duration steps, and cohort selectors
Can simulate a rollout in the harness and produce expected weight curves
Enforcement runtime can apply live schedule to a route with 0ms control-plane impact on token path
Auto-rollback triggers on defined metric breaches and produces a rollback event in the audit log
Console shows per-step decision status, health signals, and a one-click abort/advance control
implementation_notes: Architecture: (1) DSL parser -> normalized policy model, (2) simulator + dry-run engine for pre-flight checks, (3) rollout controller that emits per-interval weight assignments and validates telemetry against guardrails, (4) enforcement hooks in routing plane to atomically switch weights. Persist policies in rollout-configs table; include schema versioning. Use existing telemetry exports (prometheus + tracing) for evaluations. All changes must be idempotent and support resume after controller restart.
progress_updates: 2026-01-14: Initial design doc posted to Confluence (link in links). Chose terse YAML-first DSL instead of JSON to improve human readability.
2026-01-21: Prototyped scheduler: step engine + jitter backoff. Early simulation shows expected weight curves.
2026-02-03: Integration tests with routing plane failed under burst shadow traffic — added token rate limiter in controller.
2026-02-10: PM review requested: added explicit per-step evaluation windows and cohort selectors per feedback.
2026-02-20: SRE requested safety fence to prevent CPU pressure loops; implemented graceful-degrade path to shadow-only mode.
2026-02-28: Preparing staging rollout with two internal routes and synthetic workload for P0 validation.
review_feedback: PM (Jordan Lee): require per-route SLA mapping and an override flag for enterprise Dedicated customers
Design (Maya Chen): Console needs an inline simulator view + diff against previous policy to avoid surprises
SRE (Priya Malhotra): add hard caps to growth velocity and require telemetry freshness >= 30s for decisions
Security (Samir O'Connor): ensure rollout config changes are signed and KMS-backed in Private deployments
testing_plan: Three-stage testing: (1) unit tests for DSL parser and normalized model, (2) simulation harness that runs 10k synthetic rollouts with randomized cohorts to validate guardrail logic, (3) canary in staging feeding production-like traffic with shadow probes and A/B checks. Include chaos tests for controller restarts and slow telemetry. All tests must pass in CI before merging to main.
rollout_schedule: Step 0: Shadow-only probe for 24h (0% live traffic, 100% shadow sample=1%)
Step 1: 0.5% live traffic for 30m evaluation window
Step 2: 1% live traffic for 1h evaluation window
Step 3: 5% live traffic for 2h evaluation window
Step 4: 20% live traffic for 4h evaluation window
Step 5: 50% live traffic for 6h evaluation window
guardrails: p95 latency increase > 30% over baseline during evaluation window -> pause and notify
5xx error rate > 0.5% absolute increase -> rollback immediately
Quality regression (task-specific eval set) drop > 2% absolute -> rollback
Token cost delta > 15% and cost-per-request spike sustained for 2 windows -> alert (manual review, not auto-rollback)
Telemetry staleness > 60s -> suspend automated advances until healthy
Shadow probe failure rate > 1% -> demote to shadow-only and create incident ticket
rollback_conditions: Immediate rollback: server_errors.5xx_rate increases by more than 0.5% absolute within evaluation window
Immediate rollback: eval_quality drops by >2% on the canonical prompt set
Pause and manual review: p95 latency increase >30% but 5xx stable
Abort rollout: controller cannot fetch fresh telemetry for two consecutive evaluation windows
Safety demotion: evidence of tokenization regression or unexpected output shape changes -> demote to previous stable variant
migration_steps: Add rollout-configs table migration (schema v1) with policy_version and signer metadata
Backfill existing active releases into normalized policy format for auditability
Deploy rollout-controller v1 to staging behind a feature flag
Enable Console simulator plugin and link policies to route settings
risks: Controller-induced oscillation if telemetry is noisy; mitigated by smoothing and min-step-duration
Unexpected model quality regressions that don’t surface in synthetic evals; mitigated with shadow probes and sampled human review
Enterprise Dedicated networks may delay telemetry; added telemetry freshness checks and configuration overrides
Cost spikes for high-traffic routes during ramp; added cost delta alerting but manual gates for sensitive customers
